description.value: Kernels Popcorn is a 100% Canadian-owned popcorn franchise founded in 1983, with this location operating as a mall kiosk on the upper level at 4820 Kingsway. The shop offers a wide range of flavoured popcorn varieties — all gluten-free and whole-grain, with no nuts used in any product or ingredient sourcing. With no on-site seating of any kind, it functions strictly as a quick grab-and-go snack stop.
